metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.0 · 1999 · Asterix and Obelix vs. Caesar
metas.description: In all of Roman territory, the village where Asterix and Obelix live is the only enclave that has not yet been dominated by the empire, thanks to the magic potion of the druid Panoramix. But Commander Detritus has a plan to change...

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.7 · 2002 · Asterix & Obelix: Mission Cleopatra
metas.description: Cleopatra, queen of Egypt, believes she can build a temple in record time and makes a bet with Julius Caesar. Her architect, however, needs the help of Asterix and Obelix to fight Romans who try to stop the construction.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.3 · 2008 · Asterix at the Olympic Games
metas.description: The Roman Brutus plans to marry Irina, the princess of Greece, but the Gaul Lovesix wants to prevent this from happening. To get her attention, his strategy is to win the Olympics, with the help of Asterix and Obelix.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.3 · 2012 · Astérix and Obélix: God Save Britannia
metas.description: Asterix and Obelix travel to Britain to help Anticlimax, Asterix's Breton cousin, defeat Julius Caesar and the invading Romans.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.1 · 2023 · Asterix & Obelix: The Middle Kingdom
metas.description: The only daughter of the Chinese emperor Han Xuandi escapes from a strict prince and seeks help from the Gauls and the two brave warriors Asterix and Obelix.
